$Comment: What the members of the Headless Horseman's fight see as he rises and the fight begins: a big
banner, his line and, under it, the two things that win the fight. His binding row points its
Feedback.Engaged). Keys are lines in this pack's hallowseve.world.lang, written bare.
The moment fires once per member. The banner always reaches the members (ToParticipants) and
anyone else standing within RadiusBlocks of them, which keeps it inside this one graveyard: the
graveyards of one copy share a world but stand far further apart than this. MinSecondsBetween
folds the members' fires into one banner. It is kept per world, so it stays short: a long one
would swallow the banner of another party whose fight begins in the same copy moments later.
